description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and constants related to TunerStudio protocol handling in firmware. It declares functions for command handling, page management, debugging, and state updates specific to TunerStudio integration.

methods.name: handlePlainCommand
methods.description: Handles non-CRC wrapped TunerStudio commands received via channel.

methods.name: tunerStudioHandleCrcCommand
methods.description: Handles CRC-wrapped TunerStudio commands.

methods.name: handleTestCommand
methods.description: Processes custom test commands for rusEfi.

methods.name: handleQueryCommand
methods.description: Handles initialization protocol query commands.

methods.name: handleOutputChannelsCommand
methods.description: Refreshes gauge/output channel data.

methods.name: getWorkingPageAddr
methods.description: Returns the memory address of a specified page.

methods.name: getTunerStudioPageSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a particular TunerStudio page.

methods.name: handleWriteValueCommand
methods.description: Handles commands to write a single byte value to a specified page and offset.

methods.name: handleWriteChunkCommand
methods.description: Handles commands to write multiple bytes (chunk) to memory.

methods.name: handlePageSelectCommand
methods.description: Handles page select commands via Protocol.

methods.name: handlePageReadCommand
methods.description: Handles page read requests from TunerStudio.

methods.name: handleBurnCommand
methods.description: Handles burn command to write data to flash memory.

methods.name: tunerStudioDebug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages related to TunerStudio communication.

methods.name: tunerStudioError
methods.description: Logging or handling error messages for TunerStudio.

methods.name: updateTunerStudioState
methods.description: Updates the current state of TunerStudio output channels.

methods.name: printTsStats
methods.description: Prints internal TunerStudio protocol statistics.

methods.name: requestBurn
methods.description: Requests a flash memory burn process.

methods.name: startTunerStudioConnectivity
methods.description: Initializes TunerStudio communication/connection.

methods.name: syncTunerStudioCopy
methods.description: Synchronizes TunerStudio data buffers with firmware memory.

methods.name: runBinaryProtocolLoop
methods.description: Main loop to process TunerStudio binary protocol messages.
